manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball rises, stops for an instant, then falls. Gravity's arrow never changes.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed up on a fixed height scale. The blue arrow shows velocity and vanishes at the top. The dashed arrow shows gravity, constant throughout.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
